source_caption:
𝐓𝐇𝐈𝐒 𝐒𝐂𝐄𝐍𝐄 𝐀𝐋𝐎𝐍𝐄 𝐒𝐇𝐎𝐔𝐋𝐃 𝐋𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐇𝐄𝐍𝐑𝐘 𝐂𝐀𝐕𝐈𝐋𝐋 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐉𝐀𝐌𝐄𝐒 𝐁𝐎𝐍𝐃 𝐑𝐎𝐋𝐄⁣ 👀 
⁣
Henry Cavill’s famous “arm reload” in 𝐌𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧: 𝐈𝐦𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐅𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐮𝐭 (𝟐𝟎𝟏𝟖) lasts only a few seconds, but somehow became the most memorable moment in the entire movie. ⁣
⁣
During the bathroom fight, Cavill aggressively pumps his arms as if he’s literally reloading his fists. But look closely and something strange happens. As Cavill performs the move, his beard suddenly appears noticeably thicker, while a shirt pocket seems to magically appear between shots. ⁣
⁣
Cavill eventually joined in on the joke, saying: “I punch so hard when reloading my fists, I actually grew a beard in that moment.”⁣
⁣
If the next James Bond needs the right mix of physical presence, confidence and old-school action-star energy, this scene alone makes a pretty convincing argument that Henry Cavill should be the man for the job.

source_details.title: Mission: Impossible – Fallout
source_details.synopsis: Mission: Impossible – Fallout is a 2018 American action spy film written and directed by Christopher McQuarrie. It is the sequel to Mission: Impossible – Rogue Nation (2015) and the sixth installment in the Mission: Impossible film series. The ensemble cast includes Tom Cruise, Henry Cavill, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg, Rebecca Ferguson, Sean Harris, Angela Bassett, Vanessa Kirby, Michelle Monaghan, and Alec Baldwin. Set two years after the events of Rogue Nation, Fallout follows Impossible Missions Force agent Ethan Hunt (Cruise) and his team in their efforts to prevent a nuclear attack by terrorist Solomon Lane (Harris) and the mysterious extremist John Lark.
